summary_en: This phase II trial tests vismodegib, the FAK inhibitor GSK2256098, capivasertib, and abemaciclib in patients with progressive intracranial meningioma. All four drugs are taken by mouth: vismodegib once daily, the FAK inhibitor twice daily, capivasertib twice daily on days 1 to 4 of each 28-day cycle, and abemaciclib every 12 hours, with cycles repeating every 28 days without disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a phase II trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II evalúa vismodegib, el inhibidor de FAK GSK2256098, capivasertib y abemaciclib en pacientes con meningioma intracraneal progresivo. Los cuatro medicamentos se toman por vía oral: vismodegib una vez al día, el inhibidor de FAK dos veces al día, capivasertib dos veces al día los días 1 a 4 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y abemaciclib cada 12 horas; los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días mientras no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un ensayo de fase II.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with progressive or residual intracranial meningioma confirmed by central pathology review.
Tumor sample with a listed gene mutation or copy number change, confirmed by the central laboratory.
Measurable disease of at least 10 mm in both dimensions on MRI or CT.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Blood counts, kidney function, and liver tests within the limits set by the study.
not_for: Metastatic meningioma outside the central nervous system.
Known active hepatitis B or C.
Past or current interstitial lung disease.
Chemotherapy within 28 days, or nitrosourea or mitomycin C within 6 weeks, before registration.
